title: BNCI 2015-006 Music BCI dataset
description: EEG recordings from 11 healthy participants performing a multi-streamed auditory oddball task with polyphonic music. Participants selectively attended to one of three concurrent instruments (Synth-Pop or Jazz clips) and counted deviant patterns. ERP analyses show subject- and instrument-specific responses including P300 and early auditory components. The attended instrument could be classified offline with a mean accuracy of 91%, supporting polyphonic music as a stimulus for auditory brain–computer interfaces.
methods_description: 64-channel active-electrode EEG (Brain Products actiCAP, left mastoid reference) was recorded at 1000 Hz while participants listened to 40-second polyphonic music clips and attended to a cued instrument. Data were downsampled, low-pass filtered (Chebyshev, 42 Hz), epoched (-200 to 1200 ms), baseline corrected and artifact rejected. Classification used LDA with shrinkage covariance and leave-one-clip-out cross-validation.
